models.weight_checks: Full SHA256; official CPU-only compatibility export; all retained tensors exactly equal source. No model objects constructed.

mappings.policy: Retain official text lookup; each original annotation supplies GT video/time. Score by original index.

data_observations.policy: Preserve official labels and prediction-time clipping; do not repair or remove benchmark examples.
data_observations.boundary_interpretation: Published annotation and source metadata have different durations. Arithmetic checks do not establish raw-video content, correct source FPS, or original paper alignment. Retain official labels and arrays for the declared baseline; no guessed duration/FPS repairs.

cpu_initial_retrieval_diagnostic.note: Initial published vectors only; CPU float32 backend, not final Stage2 results.

processor.scope: Actual local HF processor on CPU; no visual encoder forward pass or vLLM engine execution.

temporal_axis_caveat.issue: Official presampled-NPY metadata uses target fps=1 and sequential indices; source sampled timestamps are not forwarded. Long videos may receive a shorter apparent timeline.
temporal_axis_caveat.decision: Preserve official checkpoint inference for baseline smoke; no undocumented timestamp, FPS, duration, or GT correction. Passing engineering preflight does not establish exact paper temporal alignment.

full_entry.output_policy: Fresh independent directory; no smoke outputs or lazy network downloads.

not_verified: Full 16966-query model execution and final scores
